reason: I'd run the free scan out of curiosity, but I won't pay a yearly fee for ratings from an app with no doctor or dietitian behind them. I also cancel anything that auto-renews after a trial, so this would be a no from me.
objection: Is this advice from an actual doctor or dietitian?
would_change_my_mind: A named clinician or registered dietitian standing behind the ratings, plus a plan that does not auto-renew after the trial.
